title: Feature switches QA: second desktop retest
eyebrow: QA · feature switches (#535) and phase 3 (#495) · plugin 2.81.2 on AjsAgent/phase-3-handoff

short.lead: The desktop app runs the house-rules copy added to your claude.ai account, never the one tools/use_branch.py installs; with that account copy switched off, 2.81.1 saved and pushed from the desktop app, and the pickup note reached Claude. Plugin 2.81.2 makes your two changes: the end-of-turn line says your work is saved, with the file count and save time, and Claude opens its first reply with one line saying what the pickup found, because the desktop app shows no session-start notice. verify.py passes 1253 of 1253 checks and tools/verify_tools.py 54 of 54.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was run and what it showed.
items: The desktop app runs the account copy

Your search found house-rules 2.80.0 under AppData\Local\Claude-Data\...\rpm\..., and the session's notice said installed copy is 2.80.0. With the account copy switched off, the desktop session printed saved 8 changed file(s) on AjsAgent/qa-pickup ... and pushed the save to GitHub; I fetched that save here and it holds qa-note.txt to qa-note-8.txt. The version-check gap for the account copy is issue #539.

verify.py checks the end-of-turn line reads your work is saved on GitHub: 1 file(s) on AjsAgent/ps, saved at HH:MM UTC. Nothing changed after that., and that the pickup note ends by asking Claude to open its first reply with one line about what it found. tools/use_branch.py installed 2.81.2 at commit 8ab0039 in a throwaway settings folder here.
A save runs after the PowerShell tool

The save's matcher in hooks/hooks.json now names PowerShell, the shell tool on Windows. Live through the shipped run.sh here: a PowerShell call that made ps.txt printed "house-rules autosave: saved 1 changed file(s) on AjsAgent/live (ps.txt) and pushed the save to GitHub." and the test's stand-in for GitHub held refs/house-rules/saves/AjsAgent/live/bc682dda.
Every save and pickup says what it did

Live through run.sh: the end of a turn printed "saved 2 changed file(s) ... and pushed the save to GitHub", then "nothing on AjsAgent/live changed since the last save". The pickup printed "gave Claude the handoff for AjsAgent/live". verify.py also proves the not-a-git-folder line, the nothing-to-pick-up line, and silence with HOUSE_RULES_TRACE=off.
A branch build is checked against its own branch

versioncheck reads the branch from known_marketplaces.json. Against real GitHub, both download routes returned 2.81.0 for AjsAgent/phase-3-handoff (before the bump). tools/use_branch.py, run here in a throwaway settings folder, installed 2.81.1 at commit 90f68b1.
A comma ends a feature name
"Feature switches, the desktop app does not save" now reads as the feature Feature switches (verify.py, design_loop part).
Four steps in the desktop app
Keep the account copy of house-rules switched off in the desktop app. Follow the 3 step cards under "Second retest: plugin 2.81.2" at the end of docs/plans/2026-11-17-phase-3-qa-steps.md.

unverified: Whether Claude really opens its first reply with the pickup line in the desktop app: it is an instruction to the model, not a notice the app shows
